title: Circular Queue
definition: A fixed-size queue implementation using an array where the end of the queue connects back to the beginning via modulo arithmetic, avoiding memory reallocation.
simpleExplanation: A Ferris Wheel. Once all the seats are full, new passengers can only get on if someone else gets off.
